name: AJAX Engineering Ltd
title: AJAX Engineering Ltd - 544356 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 1.7% to INR475 cr and EBITDA margin down 70bp to 12.5%; management calls Q2 'fairly challenging' and says 12% full-year margin looks challenging, with no capacity or capex signal.

summary.headline: AJAX Q1 FY27 revenue rose 1.7% to INR475 crores and EBITDA margin fell 70 bps to 12.5%, with SLCM market share at 75.1%.
summary.overview: Total revenue grew 1.7% YoY to INR475 crores while EBITDA fell to INR59 crores from INR61 crores, compressing margin by 70 bps to 12.5%. Profit after tax rose 5% to INR55.6 crores. Management said industry SLCM registrations fell 27% and AJAX's fell 21%, yet SLCM and retail market share rose to 75.1% from about 69% a year earlier. Management guided Q2 as seasonally soft and margins as challenging, with input cost pressure from steel and fuel and a further calibrated price increase under evaluation.

financial_highlights.change: vs INR61 crores in Q1 FY26
vs about 69% in Q1 FY26 and 73.5% in FY26

financial_highlights.value: exceeding INR1,100 crores as of June 2026

segments.name: SLCM
segments.commentary: Revenue of INR388 crores, marginally up YoY on favourable mix and Q4 FY26 price increase of about 2%. Machine volumes down; UDAAN sold 121 units in Q1 versus 202 in all of last year, with about 35-40 in July.

segments.name: Non-SLCM (concrete pumps, batching plants, boom pumps/placers)
segments.commentary: Revenue around INR48 crores, up 6.4% YoY led by pumps. Business volume about 129 machines in Q1 FY27 versus about 153 in Q1 FY26, with rain-related deferrals expected to recover in August-September.

segments.name: Spares and services
segments.commentary: Revenue INR39 crores, up 6.2% YoY; management is prioritising a higher AMC share from the installed base, but gave no quantified target.

segments.name: Exports
segments.commentary: Export share about 9% of Q1 revenue on first slip-form paver shipment. Algeria, Morocco and Nigeria about 38% of shipments; management targets about 30% CAGR over next three years, if not more.

guidance_outlook: Q2 FY27 expected to be seasonally soft and a fairly challenging quarter for EBITDA; 12.5% margin looks challenging in Q2.
Margins expected to return to about 12.5% corridor from Q3 FY27 if volumes improve.
Full-year EBITDA margin of 12% described as challenging; management said too early to call full-year numbers.
Non-SLCM growth target of about 10-15% YoY on a lower base; H2 expected to be better than H1.
Long-term EBITDA margin corridor of 13-15% reiterated; Q4 FY26 cited as about 15%.
Another calibrated price increase under evaluation, with some action targeted within Q2 FY27; about 60% of revenue typically comes in H2.
capex_capacity: ARGO 4000 launch planned in Q2 FY27 to fill a portfolio gap.
Manufacturing consolidated under one leader; Obadenahalli plant head now oversees procurement and supply chain.
Strategic inventory built in first few months for products with imported components; no large strategic steel purchase made at current prices.
Cash above INR1,100 crores; management actively pursuing inorganic opportunities with guardrails, no timeline given.
demand_pricing: Industry SLCM registrations down 27% YoY in Q1; AJAX down 21%. Second-ranked player lost about 0.7% share; Conmat and Venus gained share.

State-wise: Maharashtra and MP volumes declined (MP about 50%) but share rose; Gujarat volumes up about 40% with share 71% to 82%; Rajasthan volumes down 21% with share 66% to 86%; Odisha share 61% to 88% with volume up 13%; UP down about 7%.
Application mix: roads about 40-43%, urban infra 15-20% and buildings 10-15% (now about 35-40% combined per management, up from 15-20%).
Contractors facing payment delays from some state governments; government infrastructure spending below budget.
Steel E250 and E350 prices have risen; fuel prices also up. Price increase of about 2% taken in Q4 FY26.
Management said it is not playing the price game and prefers installation over discounting.

qa_highlights.question: Is non-SLCM growth targeted at 20-30% for the year given the low base?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it would be happy with 10-15% growth in non-SLCM on a lower base, with H2 expected better than H1.

qa_highlights.question: Why did other expenses rise about 17% on flat revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO attributed it to higher outward freight from diesel prices and export mix, plus about INR16 million of cost for the SAP ECC 6 to HANA migration this year.

qa_highlights.question: Why did a peer grow volume about 17%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the peer grows in pick-and-carry cranes, not SLCM; AJAX's SLCM decline was in line with industry registrations being down 27%.

qa_highlights.question: What is the margin outlook for Q2, Q3 and full year?
qa_highlights.answer: Q2 12.5% margin looks challenging; margins to return to about 12.5% from Q3 if volumes improve; 12% for full year also looks challenging.

qa_highlights.question: What is the steel and pricing outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Steel prices rose; management hopes for softening after US primaries in September-November; a calibrated price increase is planned, likely starting within Q2.

qa_highlights.question: Are inorganic opportunities being pursued aggressively given the cash?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is aggressively pursuing inorganic opportunities within guardrails and will update when clear.

risks_watch: Continued SLCM volume decline (industry -27%, AJAX -21%) and weak Maharashtra and MP volumes.
Steel and fuel cost inflation with unclear timing of price increases and possible competitive pushback.
Government payment delays to contractors and under-spending on infrastructure.
Recovery of deferred non-SLCM volumes expected August-September; need to verify.
Export revenue recognition timing and country/currency risk.
Investor-call audio quality issues reported by several participants during the call.
summary.management_tone: Confident on long-term growth and market share, but cautious on the near term: management repeatedly deferred to H2 and called Q2 margins challenging. Evasive on specifics for non-SLCM growth, the full-year margin, and cost initiatives.
key_quotes: Our SLCM and retail market share expanded to 75.1% during Q1 FY27, increasing from about 69% in Q1 FY26 and 73.5% during the full year FY26.
Definitely 12.5%, looks challenging at this point in time from a second quarter perspective.
For the longer term, the 13% to 15% corridor is something that we are very clear about that we will endeavor to make sure that as demand comes back to the economy, that should play.

growth.why: No overall revenue guidance; Q2 seen as seasonally soft with 12.5% quarterly margin called challenging and full-year 12% margin called challenging, while non-SLCM is guided to 10-15% growth and exports to a 30% CAGR over three years, both with only vague backing (no capacity, orders or contracts quantified), and a new ARGO 4000 launch in Q2 FY27 is planned without capacity figures.
